Operations Manager, logistics, Pune. You will lead warehouse and dispatch teams, manage inventory in SAP, improve on-time delivery, and ensure safety and compliance. We expect 6+ years in logistics or supply chain, team leadership, strong Excel, vendor management and process improvement. Knowledge of Lean or Six Sigma is a plus. You will report on KPIs such as delivery performance and stock accuracy, train supervisors, and work with transport partners. Ownership, calm under pressure, and clear communication with both floor staff and senior leadership are essential for success in this role every single day.
Certifications such as Lean Six Sigma, PMP or ITIL are valued, along with Power BI or Tableau for KPI dashboards, and Looker for reports.
